name: Mahou Koujo Arika
source:
Arika enters womanhood and faces the "Cave of Trials" to claim her title as Magical Princess proper.

Inside the cafe are monsters and traps of a devious sort. Can she emerge a woman?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ070757.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
